en.name: Heretic
en.ability: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.
en.flavor: After the hail has smashed the roof and splintered the glass of the Cathedral windows, it melts again into the earth, like a dying lamb in the desert sun. Such is the parable of the madman.

revisions.v1: Whoever wins, loses & whoever loses, wins, even if you are dead.
